services.desc: Voted #1 Aerial Adventure Park in America for Three Years! - USA TODAY (2019, 2020, 2022 Branson’s Best Zipline! Enjoy the beauty of the Ozark Mountains from the highest point in Southwest Missouri as you zip from tree to tree on the top-rated Zipline Canopy Tour at Shepherd’s Adventure Park. Guests will experience breathtaking views and thrills as they zip their way across the horizon from 8 unique tree-suspended platforms. Whether it is your first time or you are an experienced adventurer, we have a tour for you. Some light hiking and stairs are involved in the tour. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: We’d love to have your school or class group out here on the historic farm! While our farm provides an amazing learning opportunity about the history of the Ozarks, they will also have a blast at our Lil’ Pete’s Playland. The playland area includes mini golf, swings, slides, corn pit, petting zoo, treehouse and rope bridges, and an American Ninja Warrior Course. All students get to take a ride up to the top of Inspiration Tower! The Shepherd of the Hills has been welcoming field trips to Branson for many years, and we love the fun and and special bond that students have spending time together at the farm.
